context_for_next_testing_agent: Flicker fix and v2 map are both good on cluster preview. Measured img.map-picker-img bounding box + scroller clientWidth over 6-8 samples at 350-400ms intervals on mobile/tab/exhibitor-Ruby — all reported 0.00px jitter. Marker count = 143. If future changes touch ZoomableMap or scroller CSS, rerun this sampling pattern.
rca of the issue: Flicker RCA (already fixed by main agent): on small viewports the scroller's overflow toggled the vertical scrollbar on/off; scrollbar visibility changed clientWidth, which the ResizeObserver reported, which re-triggered measure()->re-render->overflow flip. Fix combines CSS 'scrollbar-gutter: stable' (always reserves scrollbar space so clientWidth is invariant) with a JS guard that ignores sub-2px width deltas in measure(). Verified empirically: 0.00px jitter across all tested viewports.
